newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens Nixdorf 5-mth sales, orders up.
newsitem.headline: Siemens Nixdorf 5-mth sales, orders up.

text.p: Siemens AG's computer unit Siemens Nixdorf said on Thursday that its worldwide sales had risen by 13 percent in the first five months of the 1996/97 business year.
The company also said worldwide orders rose by 14 percent over the same period.
Both figures take into account the loss of revenue from the sale of the company's high-end printer business last year, CEO Gerhard Schulmeyer said at the CEBIT technology fair.
International orders rose by 24 percent, while international sales increased 21 percent.
In Germany, both sales and orders rose by nine percent in the five-month period. The company gave no absolute or year-earlier figures.
Its international expansion was led by recovery in Europe, where Italian sales increased 36 percent, Austrian sales, rose 25 percent and French sales rose 19 percent.
